name: GDP per capita PPP
limitation: National output is not household disposable income

name: Unemployment
limitation: Modeled ILO estimate definitions and informal employment matter

name: Output per employed person
limitation: Overlaps GDP per capita use as sensitivity

name: Consumer price inflation
limitation: Neither high inflation nor deflation is unconditionally desirable

name: Infant mortality
limitation: Modeled estimates and correlated health outcomes

name: Secondary educational attainment
limitation: Sparse survey coverage and qualifications differ

name: Electricity access
limitation: Ceiling effect and no quality measurement

name: Gini index
limitation: Income versus consumption and survey comparability require review

name: International poverty rate
limitation: PPP poverty threshold must be read from saved source metadata

name: Female to male participation ratio
limitation: Not a complete gender equality measure and values above parity complicate direction

name: Trade share
limitation: Strongly affected by size geography and entrepot trade

name: Weighted applied tariff
limitation: Import weights endogenous and non tariff barriers excluded

name: FDI net inflows
limitation: Volatile financial flows and conduit economies

name: Government effectiveness
limitation: Perception index check vintage and uncertainty

name: Government consumption
limitation: NOT a measure of industrial policy or state ownership

name: Population
limitation: Contemporary population not historical boundary harmonization
